Raagini is a name that is deeply rooted in Indian culture and represents the harmony and rhythm of life.

historical_references.reference: Raagini is mentioned as the queen of the Yakshas in Hindu mythology. The Yakshas are believed to be nature deities, guardians of the earth, and protectors of music and dance. Raagini is depicted as the goddess of music, particularly melancholic and erotic ragas.

In the Indian epic Mahabharata, Raagini is the name of a Gandharva queen, the wife of Chitrasena. Gandharvas are celestial musicians and singers, and they are believed to have the power to create and control music and emotions. Raagini is described as having the ability to enchant everyone with her melodious voice and bewitching beauty.
